CatBoostClassifier.predict_proba.tolerance_justification: R's catboost.predict(..., prediction_type='Probability') returns a single column (P(class 1)) for binary Logloss; Python's predict_proba() duplicates this as [P(0), P(1)] -- compared against Python's 2nd column.

CatBoostClassifier.staged_predict_proba.tolerance_justification: Same single-vs-two-column reasoning as predict_proba, applied per-stage via catboost.staged_predict(..., prediction_type='Probability').

catboost.utils.compute_training_options.tolerance_justification: No R equivalent exists: R has no function that resolves training options to their final values without training (same underlying native gap as the CLI's mode:dump-options, already recorded as untriaged-but-real in catboost-8z4.115's follow-up evidence). Genuinely missing capability, not a disposition gap -- filed as a discovered-from follow-up (catboost-8z4.116 report) rather than adding new R/src code in this disposition-only ticket.
